data.body: Correction (post-rebase): commit 491333c270 from this session was DROPPED during rebase onto origin/main because main commit f797f35de1 (fix(0172-f188): remove .claude/commands wrappers shadowing dso:* plugin skills) deleted all .claude/commands/*.md wrappers entirely — the more thorough resolution of the same root cause. Skill tool now resolves dso:* skills via plugin registration alone (no wrapper indirection), which is what was failing in worktree sessions. Re-closing as superseded.
